apiVersion: v3.1.0
kind: DataContract
id: urn:datacontract:fraud:silver-payment-events
name: Silver canonical payment events
version: 1.0.0
status: active
domain: fraud-detection
description:
  purpose: Canonical scoped payment events from accepted Bronze snapshots.
  usage: Read only snapshots referenced by an accepted Silver receipt. Join provenance by integration and event identity.
  limitations: Decision and future outcome fields are not predecision features.
team:
  name: Fraud data platform
  members:
  - username: xuanphuc.a1gv
    role: owner
schema:
- name: payment_events
  physicalName: silver.payment_events
  logicalType: object
  physicalType: table
  description: One conflict-free canonical event per integration and event identity.
  properties:
  - name: event_id
    logicalType: string
    physicalType: string
    required: true
    description: Opaque event identity. Repeated deliveries retain this identity and identical content.
  - name: payment_id
    logicalType: string
    physicalType: string
    required: true
    description: Payment aggregate identity within integration_id.
  - name: aggregate_version
    logicalType: integer
    physicalType: long
    required: true
    description: Consecutive authoritative transition number starting at one; delivery duplicates do not increment it.
  - name: integration_id
    logicalType: string
    physicalType: string
    required: true
    description: Dedicated synthetic integration namespace; never share it with a real integration.
  - name: occurred_at
    logicalType: timestamp
    physicalType: timestamp
    logicalTypeOptions: &id001
      timezone: true
      defaultTimezone: UTC
    required: true
    description: Business occurrence time in UTC at microsecond precision.
  - name: recorded_at
    logicalType: timestamp
    physicalType: timestamp
    logicalTypeOptions: *id001
    required: true
    description: Source recording time, at or after occurred_at; not ingestion time.
  - name: schema_version
    logicalType: integer
    physicalType: long
    required: true
    description: Original event-envelope version, independent of the physical source schema.
  - name: correlation_id
    logicalType: string
    physicalType: string
    required: true
    description: Correlation identity shared across one payment history.
  - name: payment_created
    logicalType: object
    description: Initial immutable checkout snapshot. Exactly one lifecycle payload is present per event.
    properties:
    - name: merchant
      logicalType: object
      required: true
      description: Integration-scoped merchant references.
      properties:
      - name: merchant_id
        logicalType: string
        physicalType: string
        required: true
        description: Gateway merchant identity.
      - name: external_seller_id
        logicalType: string
        physicalType: string
        required: true
        description: Integration seller identity.
    - name: customer
      logicalType: object
      required: true
      description: Integration-scoped customer references.
      properties:
      - name: customer_id
        logicalType: string
        physicalType: string
        required: true
        description: Gateway customer identity.
      - name: external_buyer_id
        logicalType: string
        physicalType: string
        required: true
        description: Integration buyer identity.
    - name: snapshot
      logicalType: object
      required: true
      description: Checkout facts captured at creation; raw personal and payment credentials are excluded.
      properties:
      - name: external_order_id
        logicalType: string
        physicalType: string
        required: true
        description: Integration order reference.
      - name: total
        logicalType: object
        required: true
        description: Total in integer minor units; must equal the item sum.
        properties: &id002
        - name: minor_units
          logicalType: integer
          physicalType: long
          required: true
          description: Nonnegative integer amount in currency minor units.
        - name: currency
          logicalType: string
          physicalType: string
          required: true
          description: Three-letter uppercase currency code shared by all items.
      - name: items
        logicalType: array
        required: true
        description: Nonempty checkout line items.
        items:
          logicalType: object
          required: true
          properties:
          - name: product_id
            logicalType: string
            physicalType: string
            required: true
            description: Product reference.
          - name: category
            logicalType: string
            physicalType: string
            required: true
            description: Refurbished electronics product type, such as phone, laptop or accessory.
          - name: condition
            logicalType: string
            physicalType: string
            required: true
            description: 'Refurbished condition grade: excellent, good or fair.'
          - name: quantity
            logicalType: integer
            physicalType: int
            required: true
            description: Positive item quantity.
          - name: unit_price
            logicalType: object
            required: true
            description: Price for one item in checkout currency.
            properties: *id002
      - name: merchant_account_created_at
        logicalType: timestamp
        physicalType: timestamp
        logicalTypeOptions: *id001
        required: true
        description: Merchant account creation time.
      - name: customer_account_created_at
        logicalType: timestamp
        physicalType: timestamp
        logicalTypeOptions: *id001
        required: true
        description: Customer account creation time.
      - name: shipping
        logicalType: object
        required: true
        description: Coarse shipping geography and synthetic address fingerprint.
        properties:
        - name: country
          logicalType: string
          physicalType: string
          required: true
          description: Shipping country code.
        - name: region
          logicalType: string
          physicalType: string
          required: true
          description: Shipping region.
        - name: postal_code
          logicalType: string
          physicalType: string
          required: true
          description: Shipping postal code.
        - name: address_fingerprint
          logicalType: string
          physicalType: string
          required: true
          description: Normalized keyed synthetic address fingerprint; no street lines.
  - name: attempt_started
    logicalType: object
    description: Starts a new nonconcurrent attempt on an open payment.
    properties:
    - name: attempt_id
      logicalType: string
      physicalType: string
      required: true
      description: Attempt identity unique within this payment.
    - name: signals
      logicalType: object
      required: true
      description: Runtime observations; unavailable optional signals remain null.
      properties:
      - name: attempted_at
        logicalType: timestamp
        physicalType: timestamp
        logicalTypeOptions: *id001
        required: true
        description: Attempt occurrence time.
      - name: payment_method
        logicalType: object
        required: true
        description: Method category and keyed synthetic token fingerprint.
        properties:
        - name: type
          logicalType: string
          physicalType: string
          required: true
          description: Payment method category.
        - name: fingerprint
          logicalType: string
          physicalType: string
          required: true
          description: Synthetic method fingerprint; never raw credentials.
      - name: device_fingerprint
        logicalType: string
        physicalType: string
        description: Observed synthetic device fingerprint.
      - name: ip_country
        logicalType: string
        physicalType: string
        description: Resolved IP country if available.
      - name: ip_network_fingerprint
        logicalType: string
        physicalType: string
        description: Keyed network fingerprint; never raw IP.
      - name: user_agent_family
        logicalType: string
        physicalType: string
        description: Optional observed browser family.
        customProperties:
        - property: sinceSchemaVersion
          value: 2
    - name: context
      logicalType: object
      required: true
      description: Immutable scoring context matching PaymentCreated and the Fraud request.
      properties:
      - name: merchant
        logicalType: object
        required: true
        description: Integration-scoped merchant references.
        properties:
        - name: merchant_id
          logicalType: string
          physicalType: string
          required: true
          description: Gateway merchant identity.
        - name: external_seller_id
          logicalType: string
          physicalType: string
          required: true
          description: Integration seller identity.
      - name: customer
        logicalType: object
        required: true
        description: Integration-scoped customer references.
        properties:
        - name: customer_id
          logicalType: string
          physicalType: string
          required: true
          description: Gateway customer identity.
        - name: external_buyer_id
          logicalType: string
          physicalType: string
          required: true
          description: Integration buyer identity.
      - name: snapshot
        logicalType: object
        required: true
        description: Checkout facts captured at creation; raw personal and payment credentials are excluded.
        properties:
        - name: external_order_id
          logicalType: string
          physicalType: string
          required: true
          description: Integration order reference.
        - name: total
          logicalType: object
          required: true
          description: Total in integer minor units; must equal the item sum.
          properties: &id003
          - name: minor_units
            logicalType: integer
            physicalType: long
            required: true
            description: Nonnegative integer amount in currency minor units.
          - name: currency
            logicalType: string
            physicalType: string
            required: true
            description: Three-letter uppercase currency code shared by all items.
        - name: items
          logicalType: array
          required: true
          description: Nonempty checkout line items.
          items:
            logicalType: object
            required: true
            properties:
            - name: product_id
              logicalType: string
              physicalType: string
              required: true
              description: Product reference.
            - name: category
              logicalType: string
              physicalType: string
              required: true
              description: Refurbished electronics product type, such as phone, laptop or accessory.
            - name: condition
              logicalType: string
              physicalType: string
              required: true
              description: 'Refurbished condition grade: excellent, good or fair.'
            - name: quantity
              logicalType: integer
              physicalType: int
              required: true
              description: Positive item quantity.
            - name: unit_price
              logicalType: object
              required: true
              description: Price for one item in checkout currency.
              properties: *id003
        - name: merchant_account_created_at
          logicalType: timestamp
          physicalType: timestamp
          logicalTypeOptions: *id001
          required: true
          description: Merchant account creation time.
        - name: customer_account_created_at
          logicalType: timestamp
          physicalType: timestamp
          logicalTypeOptions: *id001
          required: true
          description: Customer account creation time.
        - name: shipping

          description: Coarse shipping geography and synthetic address fingerprint.
          properties:
          - name: country
            logicalType: string

          - name: region

          - name: postal_code

            description: Shipping postal code.
          - name: address_fingerprint
            logicalType: string

            required: true
            description: Normalized keyed synthetic address fingerprint; no street lines.
  - name: risk_decision_recorded
    logicalType: object
    description: Exactly one assessment for the active attempt before any processor request.
    properties:
    - name: attempt_id
      logicalType: string

      logicalType: object
      required: true
      description: Decision evidence. Optional model and feature versions are absent for rules-only decisions.
      properties:
      - name: outcome
        logicalType: string
        physicalType: string
        required: true
        description: RISK_OUTCOME_APPROVE or RISK_OUTCOME_DECLINE.
      - name: reason_codes
        logicalType: array
        required: true
        description: Policy reason codes; declines require at least one.
        items:
          logicalType: string
          physicalType: string
          required: true
      - name: policy_version
        logicalType: string
        physicalType: string
        required: true
        description: Evaluated policy version.
      - name: model_version
        logicalType: string
        physicalType: string
        description: Evaluated model version if a model was used.
      - name: feature_set_version
        logicalType: string
        physicalType: string
        description: Evaluated feature-set version if features were used.
      - name: risk_score
        logicalType: number
        physicalType: double
        description: Optional model risk score.
      - name: assessment_id
        logicalType: string
        physicalType: string
        description: Optional assessment reference; synthetic references do not identify a persisted Fraud document.
      - name: evidence_sha256
        logicalType: string
        physicalType: string
        description: Optional evidence hash; historical synthetic evidence follows the source contract serialization.
  - name: processor_operation_requested
    logicalType: object
    description: Processor authorization request after risk approval.
    properties:
    - name: attempt_id
      logicalType: string
      physicalType: string
      required: true
      description: Active approved attempt identity.
    - name: operation_key
      logicalType: string
      physicalType: string
      required: true
      description: Idempotent processor operation identity.
  - name: processor_outcome_unknown
    logicalType: object
    description: Pending processor result; only processor decline or success can resolve it.
    properties:
    - name: attempt_id
      logicalType: string
      physicalType: string
      required: true
      description: Active requested attempt identity.
  - name: attempt_declined
    logicalType: object
    description: Risk or processor decline that permits a subsequent attempt.
    properties:
    - name: attempt_id
      logicalType: string
      physicalType: string
      required: true
      description: Active declined attempt identity.
    - name: source
      logicalType: string
      physicalType: string
      required: true
      description: DECLINE_SOURCE_RISK or DECLINE_SOURCE_PROCESSOR.
    - name: reason
      logicalType: string
      physicalType: string
      required: true
      description: Decline reason.
  - name: payment_succeeded
    logicalType: object
    description: Terminal successful processor result.
    properties:
    - name: attempt_id
      logicalType: string
      physicalType: string
      required: true
      description: Successful requested attempt identity.
    - name: processor_reference
      logicalType: string
      physicalType: string
      required: true
      description: Synthetic processor result reference.
  - name: payment_expired
    logicalType: object
    description: Terminal expiry with no pending processor result.
    properties:
    - name: _present
      logicalType: boolean
      physicalType: boolean
      required: true
      description: True marker for the otherwise empty expiry payload.
  - name: _source_schema_version
    logicalType: integer
    physicalType: int
    required: true
    description: Declared physical input schema version, independent of the event envelope.
  - name: _candidate_id
    logicalType: string
    physicalType: string
    required: true
    description: Candidate that last changed this row; the accepted receipt identifies the complete snapshot.

body.termsOfUse:
Canonical scoped payment events from accepted Bronze snapshots.

Read only snapshots referenced by an accepted Silver receipt. Join provenance by integration and event identity.

Decision and future outcome fields are not predecision features.
